name: Guangzhou New Year's Cube Day 2015

venue.name: Guangzhou Nanwu Secondary School

information: It is a relaxed competition with short-timed events in half a day. Only one round for all the events will be carried out. Just pick up your cubes and enjoy the competition in the New Year's Day!
